title: Tencent Launches Hy Translation App, Supports 33 Languages and Offline Translation, Focuses on Travel Abroad Scenarios

content_html:
On September 24, Tencent officially launched its new translation product "Hy Translate" app, positioned as an "all-in-one translation assistant," focusing on scenarios such as travel abroad and business communication. The application is currently available in multiple countries and regions, including the United States, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia.

According to the introduction, "Hy Translate" supports bidirectional translation of 33 major languages and covers five ethnic minority languages and dialects: Tibetan, Uyghur, Mongolian, Kazakh, and Korean. In terms of functions, the app offers various modes such as voice translation, photo translation, conversation translation, and offline translation, meeting users' needs in environments without network access.
